ops.title: af22212462a0 verbose-comment guard warns (not blocks) on edits to already-over-budget comments; position-mapped ancestry; NO release tag cut
ops.body:
Shipped 2026-07-23 as af22212462a0 on main (CI+docs green). The `general` pack's verbose-comment guard now hard-blocks only comment runs an edit genuinely creates; reworking a run that was ALREADY over budget pre-edit fires a new `LegacyCommentEdit` nudge instead. Semantics locked by user: grown-from-within-budget, reflow-to-oversize, and new-file-Write carry-overs still BLOCK; a full in-place rewrite (even delete-and-replace at the same spot) WARNS; a moved-and-edited run blocks by design (SequenceMatcher won't align out-of-order moves). Machinery: `touched_comment_ancestry` in `ast_grep.py` — exact-key pass with per-instance consumption preferring the positionally-corresponding twin, then a position pass mapping old too_long blocks' spans through SequenceMatcher opcodes; `touched_comment_blocks` is re-derived from it and `TestTouchedCommentBlocks` is the byte-equivalence guard (finder fuzzed 10k+ trials, 0 mismatches). `VerboseComment` kept its name (test_pack_tools litmus imports it).

CHANGELOG carries a provisional `## [12.10.0]` heading but NO tag was cut — pick the real number from PyPI at tag time ([[concurrent-release-race-protocol]]). A concurrent session's docs commit 6181e9a8 swept my packs.qmd bullet hunk into itself mid-wave ([[reposync-auto-commits-code-repos]] territory — re-diff at ship time caught it). Workflow `args` arrived stringified AGAIN despite passing a JSON object — scripts must open with `typeof args === 'string' ? JSON.parse(args) : args` or lanes dispatch with undefined prompts and improvise ([[workflow-script-pitfalls]]). Related: [[comment-guard-doc-ceiling-shipped]] (the 6/400 head + 3/200 tail budgets this guard still enforces).
